title: GAP Waiver Premier 150 Exclusions: Installment Amount for Deferred Installments
content:
The deferral part of the GAP Waiver Addenda Premier 150 excluded total uses an installment amount. That amount follows the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act rate cap in effect on the effective date of the latest extension the Retail Installment Contracts contract records.

**Records read.** The latest cap-applied record, the latest cap-ended record and the latest extension are each the record of its kind with the latest effective date. Where two records of one kind share that date, the one recorded first counts.

**Rule.**

- **Cap in effect on the extension's date.** When a cap had taken effect on or before the latest extension's effective date and had not ended by it, the installment amount is the installment the cap set.
- **Cap starting after the extension.** When that extension took effect before a cap that has not ended, the installment amount is the level installment of the signed terms. That is the amount financed times the monthly rate (the original annual percentage rate divided by 1,200), divided by one less the monthly rate plus one raised to the power of minus the original term in months, rounded half-up to the cent.
- **Otherwise** the rate cap does not change the installment amount.

| Latest extension against the cap records | Installment amount |
|---|---|
| extension on or after the cap's effective date, cap not ended by the extension's date | the cap's installment |
| extension before the cap's effective date, cap not ended | the signed-terms level installment |
| no cap, a cap that ended by the extension's date, or no extension | not changed by the rate cap |
